265:t_1:83.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here, I brought some beer. Let's have a glass to cap off the meal.」

265:t_1:84.en:
$$赤木$$
「Thanks, $$ランド$$. Beer while looking out at the galaxy isn't bad at all.」

265:t_1:85.en:
$$青山$$
「How about you, $$シモン$$? Now that you've come to the middle of the galaxy, are you getting excited too?」

265:t_1:86.en:
$$シモン$$
「Of course I am. Ever since we burst out of underground $$ジーハ村$$, we've kept climbing higher and higher.」

265:t_1:87.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now that we're this far, I feel like punching a hole through the dead center of the galaxy with my drill.」

265:t_1:88.en:
$$青山$$
「Hey, hey... We're not heading for the center of the galaxy, we're getting away from it, right?」

265:t_1:89.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now that you mention it, that's right.」

265:t_1:90.en:
$$ランド$$
「But from what I hear, you fought that famous 《$$アンチスパイラル$$》 somewhere way beyond this galaxy, didn't you?」

265:t_1:91.en:
$$シモン$$
「Back then I was desperate to get $$ニア$$ back, so until I'd beaten it, I had no room to look around me.」

265:t_1:92.en:
$$シモン$$
「Standing in the middle of the galaxy like this now, I can really feel how tiny I am...」

265:t_1:93.en:
$$シモン$$
「At the same time, I feel the urge to make this whole vast universe mine.」

265:t_1:95.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's not it... I can't put it into words well, but in this vast world, I just want to see how far I can go.」

265:t_1:96.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I get it, $$シモン$$. But right now...」

265:t_1:97.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah... It's the same feeling I had when I fought the $$アンチスパイラル$$.」

265:t_1:98.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm going back to Earth to take $$ニア$$ back from the $$サイデリアル$$.」

265:t_1:99.en:
$$青山$$
「Then the realistic move is that we'll need the help of people who can do ultra-long-range hyperspace travel.」

265:t_1:100.en:
$$ランド$$
「Why is it that guys like that show up when nobody called them, and never show up at times like this?」

265:t_1:101.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's a needless worry. They aren't going to let us get away anyway.」

265:t_1:103.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... It's not only the $$サイデリアル$$ who are after us. The $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s are too.」

265:t_1:104.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've got a feeling... A big battle is coming soon...」

265:t_2:6.en:
$$早乙女$$
「You look well, which is good to see. Not that I ever thought a man like you would give up over something this small.」

265:t_2:8.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Your foul mouth hasn't changed either. And yet $$隼人$$ and $$弁慶$$ have grown up, at least a bit.」

265:t_2:10.en:
$$早乙女$$
「This is a place that transcends time, life, and death. Your comrades are probably each hearing my voice as well.」

265:t_2:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Not only $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$, but even you came back to life, huh...!」

265:t_2:12.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Make no mistake, $$竜馬$$. Those two and I are already walking different paths.」

265:t_2:14.en:
$$ミチル$$
「The you of today should be able to listen calmly to Father's story.」

265:t_2:16.en:
$$武蔵$$
「The genuine article, the great $$巴武蔵$$ himself.」

265:t_2:17.en:
$$ミチル$$
「It's been a long time, $$竜馬$$.」

265:t_2:19.en:
$$早乙女$$
「You must know it too. That coming here was the guidance of the $$ゲッター線$$.」

265:t_2:21.en:
$$渓$$
「What's that supposed to mean, Dad! You too, Sis!」

265:t_2:22.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Honestly... Just because I'd been parasitized by the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, having $$弁慶$$ raise 《$$元気$$》 was a problem after all.」

265:t_2:23.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Father... She's not $$元気$$ now, she's $$渓$$.」

265:t_2:24.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Oh, that's right. ...Still, she's at that age, so I would have liked her to become a little more girlish.」

265:t_2:27.en:
$$早乙女$$
「$$號$$... I must thank you.」

265:t_2:29.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Thank you for protecting $$渓$$, together with the $$ゲッター線$$, all the way to today.」

265:t_2:30.en:
$$號$$
「That's my mission... the reason I was born.」

265:t_2:31.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Cut me some slack, Doctor, you and $$武蔵$$ both. I really did try my best to raise $$渓$$ to be girlish, you know.」

265:t_2:32.en:
$$武蔵$$
「At this point, the process doesn't matter! What matters is the result!」

265:t_2:35.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Thank you, $$弁慶$$. It's thanks to you that $$元気$$... that $$渓$$ grew up so strong.」

265:t_2:37.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... I'm the only one who got older, $$ミチル$$.」

265:t_2:38.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Still, I'm glad to be able to talk with you now that you're all grown up, $$隼人$$.」

265:t_2:40.en:
$$隼人$$
「...But Doctor, you didn't call us here to hold a class reunion in the middle of the galaxy, did you?」

265:t_2:41.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Of course not, $$隼人$$. There is something I must tell all of you.」

265:t_2:43.en:
$$早乙女$$
「The collapse of the universe... No, the rebirth of the universe.」

265:t_2:45.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...I heard it over and over in the $$時獄戦役$$. The story that once every 12,000 years, the universe collapses in order to be reborn.」

265:t_2:47.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And I know that $$バアル$$ get born because of it. But what does the birth of those monsters have to do with the universe's rebirth?」

265:t_2:48.en:
$$早乙女$$
「The birth of $$バアル$$ exists to erase the power of life from this universe.」

265:t_2:50.en:
$n
「That phrase... The enemy used to say it to $$バサラ$$ all the time...」

265:t_2:51.en:
$$ミチル$$
「The power of life isn't a term that refers only to 《$$アニマスピリチア$$》.」

265:t_2:52.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It is something far more universal... Something every living thing possesses.」

265:t_2:53.en:
$n
「Do you mean... the power to live...?」

265:t_2:54.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It is what governs the principle of all things... In other words, it is also the key that draws out the $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

265:t_2:55.en:
$n
「$$オリジン・ロー$$...!? You mean $$次元力$$!」

265:t_2:56.en:
$n
「Drawing out $$次元力$$ is the power of life... It's true that the $$スフィア$$s also draw out $$次元力$$ through human emotions and hearts...」

265:t_2:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I see. And what are you, who know that truth? Don't tell me you're going to call yourselves emissaries of God?」

265:t_2:59.en:
$$早乙女$$
「We are those who have entrusted our lives to the flow toward $$シンカ$$.」

265:t_2:60.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's what this is... I'm starting to see it.」
